Atlanta Capital Group decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 19.63% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atlanta Capital Group sold 11,538 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,243 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.55M, down from 58,781 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atlanta Capital Group who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $556.06 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.36% or $4.43 during the last trading session, reaching $192.1. About 17.29 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
